summary: Frontend-only test of v1.7.0: genre normalization, 'Show all in Library' person filter, and the missing-filmography section, run in the simulated electronAPI harness with a mocked TMDB (/search/person, /person/{id}/movie_credits). All new checks passed (about 55 assertions). Regression run_filmography and run_bad_open also passed with no page errors.

issues: person-filter-chip sits inside the toolbar flex row next to PDF, not above the multipart banner as a separate row. Its mb-3 makes it sit a few px higher than the neighbouring buttons. The header count still says '12 movies' while the grid shows only the person's 8.
The 'Show all in Library' button squeezes the description so 'Appears in 8 films in your library' wraps onto 2 lines.

The 'Well-known films not in your library' section is inside the same 60vh scroll list, below every owned film. For prolific people it is only seen after scrolling. Consider a separate block or a count hint.

action_items: Optional: move person-filter-chip out of the toolbar row (or drop mb-3) so it lines up with the buttons.

Optional: cache missingFilms results per person+role for the session. Reopening the dialog refetches /search/person and /movie_credits each time (seen twice per open in dev because of StrictMode; once in a production build).
critical_code_review_comments: normalizeGenres/normalizeLibraryGenres are correct: they handle strings and {name} objects, keep order, dedupe, and leave unchanged cards as the same object. They are applied on Library load, on Stats load, and in fetchMovieDetails/fetchTvDetails.
Genres added by hand in the genre-editor (e.g. 'Action & Adventure') are not normalized until the next load. Minor.
missingFilms only treats a film as owned if the library card has a tmdb_id. Owned cards without a tmdb_id can still show up as 'missing'. Minor.
LocalLibraryPage.jsx is about 3300 lines (left alone, as you asked).
seed_data_creation: None in DB. The libraries are injected per browser context with the harness init_script (TEST_ prefixed cards).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run via browser_automation: g={'page':page}; exec(open('/app/tests/test_iter42_genres_person.py').read(), g); then await run_genres(), run_genres_stats_direct(), run_person_filter(), run_missing(), run_missing_nokey(). PersonMock covers these cases: an exact name match that prefers known_for_department; owned, documentary, future, no-date, Himself and duplicate credits; and director crew jobs. openExternal is captured into window.__opened. Regression: test_iter41_filmography.py run_filmography and run_bad_open.
